sources.read_level: Before new efficiency generation, visually checked original PDF pages 2, 4, 7, 8, 10 and exact immutable text views for all 24 article-reported reference fields. Earlier ABC source views/evaluations remain historical. No original-trial reanalysis or current-prescribing recommendation.
sources.supports: Six positive open-response concrete article questions, frozen numeric/boolean values, exact per-field passage support and efficient full-context versus local retrieval comparison.

sources.title: Gemma 4 26B A4B IT model endpoints - OpenRouter public API
sources.read_level: Direct public endpoint JSON; archived NextBit endpoint fields, without credentials or inference.
sources.supports: NextBit advertises a 262144-token context and native structured outputs. Application input-byte guard is a separate constraint; listings do not prove a fresh successful inference.

sources.title: Text - PyMuPDF documentation
sources.read_level: Text extraction, natural reading order and table-content sections.
sources.supports: Creator-order text may differ from reading order; position-aware reordering is needed and table interpretation is a separate problem.

sources.title: Page - PyMuPDF documentation
sources.read_level: get_text API formats, extraction flags, sort and clipping.
sources.supports: Dictionary extraction and controlling image inclusion; coordinate sort alone is not a universal semantic reading-order solution.

sources.title: TextPage - PyMuPDF documentation
sources.read_level: extractDICT and dictionary-output block/line/span structure, including bbox and span text.
sources.supports: Actual positioned-line/span geometry used to split narrow column lines merged into one block and retain raw provenance.

sources.title: Appendix 1: Details on Text Extraction - PyMuPDF documentation
sources.read_level: Referenced API page; substantive retrieval failed with HTTP 503. Page/TextPage primary API consulted instead.
sources.supports: Unverified access; no implementation-specific conclusion depends on unseen appendix content.

separation: Researcher PDF/reference verification is not supplied as evaluator labels or gold excerpts to any answering model. All B views are the complete extraction; C views require actual tool delivery.
